scope: Retained workspace close/reopen follow-up; prior evidence remains historical and unchanged.

contractMap.ownership: Open presentation is separate from retained workspace and child identity/state.
contractMap.activation: Inactive close preserves active/focus; active close chooses next then previous; last close has active=null. Only explicit reopen and Reset open closed workspaces.
contractMap.resumption: Same child/layout/routes/receipts/draft; Review returns to its own file top, non-review retains focus.
contractMap.events: Global controls tolerate no active owner; closed child events are ignored; sample push may update closed revision without activation.
contractMap.guards: Ad hoc isolated fixture evidence, not retained CI tests.
